query:
The group decided to order pizza. What did Soo-Yeon's response to that decision reveal about her actual position, and what specifically in how she responded signals this — given that she did not object?

Options:
A. Soo-Yeon
B. Nadia
C. Lena
D. Kezia
context:
[1] (about=Soo-Yeon, episodic, t4 @2026-03-09T19:26:00) Priya mentioned pizza for tonight. Can we do something lighter? I had a heavy lunch 😅
[2] (about=Soo-Yeon, episodic, t6 @2026-03-16T19:20:00) I'll just have Raj's flatbread.

[6] (about=Lena, episodic, t14 @2026-04-20T19:13:00) so basically Soo-Yeon ran a successful theory of mind intervention tbh. she identified the barrier and reframed the proposition. elegant
[7] (about=Soo-Yeon, episodic, t14 @2026-04-20T19:12:00) I knew the design angle would land. He was always going to like it once the framing matched his background 🙂

[11] (about=Marcus, episodic, t10 @2026-03-30T19:46:00) Lena's merchant tile placement in round two signaled she was building toward Coventry. Blocking Dudley removes that route. It's spatial denial, not aggression.
[12] (about=Soo-Yeon, episodic, t14 @2026-04-20T19:20:00) Confirmed 🙂
[13] (about=Soo-Yeon, episodic, t2 @2026-04-06T19:05:00) that was the reasoning, yes 🙂
[14] (about=Soo-Yeon, episodic, t2 @2026-04-06T19:39:00) noted 🙂
[15] (about=Nadia, episodic, t12 @2026-04-13T19:36:00) Thank you. I did not say anything but I noticed that as well.

[17] (about=Nadia, episodic, t12 @2026-04-13T19:38:00) I did not want to interrupt the game.
[18] (about=Priya, episodic, t5 @2026-03-16T19:00:00) ok we're at Soo-Yeon's tonight for Wingspan 🦅 and honestly I am SO ready for this. Tomasz you owe us all an explanation for that last-round Dune betrayal last week btw
[19] (about=Kezia, episodic, t0 @2026-03-02T19:29:00) lol 47% is so specific 😂
[20] (about=Priya, episodic, t4 @2026-03-09T19:11:00) she texted, late shift at the cafe. she'll be at the next one! 😊 Nadia also skipping tonight, i think
[21] (about=Soo-Yeon, core, t4 @2026-03-09T19:01:00) Requests lighter food than pizza for tonight due to a heavy lunch.
[22] (about=Soo-Yeon, core, t4 @2026-03-09T19:01:00) Compliments Kezia's taste in groups.
[23] (about=GROUP, said_by=Priya, group-interaction, t6 @2026-03-16T19:01:00) Group decides to order pizza for the session, with majority vote; Nadia opts out.
[24] (about=GROUP, said_by=Priya, group-interaction, t4 @2026-03-09T19:01:00) Tonight's snack changed from pizza to lighter options: rice crackers, hummus, and mixed nuts.
agent_answer:
**A. Soo-Yeon**

Soo-Yeon’s response shows she did **not actually switch to being in favor of pizza**; she was **accommodating the majority decision without endorsing it**. Her actual position remained that she wanted something lighter/not pizza, because she’d already said: *“Priya mentioned pizza for tonight. Can we do something lighter? I had a heavy lunch 😅”*

The specific signal is her response after the pizza decision: **“I’ll just have Raj’s flatbread.”**  
That is not agreement with pizza — unlike Kezia’s “fine with pizza 🍕” — but a quiet opt-out: she lets the group order pizza while arranging a separate alternative for herself. So she didn’t object to the group’s choice, but her wording reveals she still did not want pizza herself.

query:
The group discussed the expectation that everyone should bring either a game or food to the annual marathon. What did Nadia's response signal about her actual relationship to this group norm, and how would you know from what she said?

Options:
A. Nadia
B. Tomasz
C. Marcus
D. Lena
context:
[1] (about=Nadia, episodic, t14 @2026-04-20T19:06:00) I will bring a game. I do not participate in the food arrangement.
[2] (about=Lena, episodic, t14 @2026-04-20T19:05:00) so basically the norm here is bring something, game or food, agreed tbh. one could argue that even the people who brought nothing last year understood this expectation, they just didn't follow through
[3] (about=Tomasz, episodic, t14 @2026-04-20T19:04:00) In my experience the marathon only works when everyone contributes. It is the social contract of a shared day.
[4] (about=Priya, episodic, t14 @2026-04-20T19:07:00) that totally counts Nadia! honestly a good game pitch is worth more than another bag of chips 😊
[5] (about=Priya, episodic, t14 @2026-04-20T19:02:00) love that. also we need to talk about the bring-something rule. last year two people showed up empty-handed, no snacks no game nothing 😅
[6] (about=Lena, episodic, t12 @2026-04-13T19:10:00) so basically that explains why Nadia didn't push back on Tomasz's Dune ruling even though everyone else was complaining tbh
[7] (about=Nadia, episodic, t6 @2026-03-16T19:22:00) No. I do not eat during sessions. Order what you want.
[8] (about=Priya, episodic, t6 @2026-03-16T19:21:00) lol ok pizza it is i guess 😅 majority wins. Nadia you want in on the order?
[9] (about=Nadia, episodic, t6 @2026-03-16T19:05:00) Yes. Everyone keep their food away from the card area please.

[11] (about=Nadia, episodic, t12 @2026-04-13T19:38:00) I did not want to interrupt the game.
[12] (about=Tomasz, episodic, t12 @2026-04-13T19:07:00) Last April. Nadia found that I was one of the few people in the group who owned the base game for that particular series. We played four sessions over six weeks.
[13] (about=Priya, episodic, t4 @2026-03-09T19:11:00) she texted, late shift at the cafe. she'll be at the next one! 😊 Nadia also skipping tonight, i think
[14] (about=Nadia, episodic, t0 @2026-03-02T19:19:00) I will be there at 7. What time do we start playing.
[15] (about=Raj, episodic, t8 @2026-03-23T19:07:00) Kezia and Felix have been a good addition to be fair. Different energy than the founding crowd 😄
[16] (about=Priya, episodic, t13 @2026-04-20T19:00:00) ok marathon planning time!! 🎲🎲 Raj you always run this, what's the format looking like this year? and yes i'm already bringing themed snacks don't even try to stop me
[17] (about=Lena, episodic, t0 @2026-03-02T19:18:00) so basically the themed snack thing is actually a nice warm-up ritual tbh, it sets the tone before the game even starts. one could argue it's part of the social contract of game night
[18] (about=Priya, episodic, t9 @2026-03-30T19:00:00) ok Lena's hosting tonight 🎉 i brought veggie samosas as snacks, hope that works for everyone? or i can grab something else if needed
[19] (about=Lena, episodic, t8 @2026-03-23T19:05:00) so basically what Tomasz did was smart pedagogy tbh, scaffolding the experience rather than throwing you in the deep end, the evidence suggests that's actually what determines whether new players stick around
[20] (about=Felix, episodic, t8 @2026-03-23T19:08:00) honestly it does feel different here than the meetup nights, like you all actually care about the games as games, not just the social thing
[21] (about=Nadia, core, t14 @2026-04-20T19:01:00) Will bring a game to the marathon but does not participate in food arrangement.
[22] (about=Nadia, core, t12 @2026-04-13T19:01:00) Explains she did not want to interrupt the game, hence not mentioning the food issue.
agent_answer:
A. Nadia

Her response signals **partial compliance with the bring-something norm**: she commits to bringing a **game**, but explicitly opts out of the **food arrangement**. You know this directly from her words: “I will bring a game. I do not participate in the food arrangement.” So she is not rejecting the norm outright—she satisfies it through a game contribution—but she draws a clear boundary around food.
